items.title: Using Social Media for Business Promotion

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Using Social Media for Business Promotion under 9.4 as printed (PDF 133, printed 129).

blocks.text: Digital platforms provide entrepreneurs with tools to start, manage, and grow their businesses online (as shown in Figure 9.4). These platforms include social media, e-commerce websites, and freelancing marketplaces. Social media helps in promoting products and reaching a large audience quickly. E-commerce platforms allow the buying and selling of goods without physical shops. Freelancing websites provide opportunities to offer skills and services globally, making entrepreneurship easier and more accessible.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The book cites Figure 9.4 here, but Figure 9.4 shows technology-based solutions; the digital platforms (social media, e-commerce, freelancing) are shown in Figure 9.5.
